summary: Layer 1B expansion found a small set of US-listed optical and EO/IR companies plausibly exposed to FY2026 NDAA-driven defense optical-glass and optical-systems de-risking. The strongest underfollowed fit is LightPath Technologies because its own 10-K ties BlackDiamond infrared glass, germanium substitution, domestic production, and DoD-funded qualification work directly to the node. Materion and Syntec Optics are second-order or speculative discovery candidates through optical coatings, subassemblies, optomechanics, and domestic optical-system manufacturing. Leonardo DRS is included as a reference/context anchor because it is a direct EO/IR defense systems supplier and potential customer or integrator layer, not because it is obscure. Teledyne FLIR and Coherent are relevant reference names but were not included due to candidate limit and/or large-cap attention; Coherent also announced a sale of its Aerospace and Defense business in 2025, so its ongoing pure defense-optics exposure requires re-verification.
